lines.text: Holiday rush at the flower shop. Let's count the messages together. One... two... three...
Just an example. Thirty messages a day... three minutes each... that's ninety minutes. Every single day.
Now the bot answers the order questions... and the florist... can finally breathe.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Get ready for the holiday rush before it starts. Comment ROSES and we'll send you the plan. You're still the captain.
